correction: A delete that timed out, or whose read afterwards failed, was marked done at once, so a view that loaded while maild still ran the Delete counted as proof and let the hold go, and a second Delete then erased the message from Trash. Such a delete now stays held while confirmDeletes reads the message back: it is done only from the read that shows it moved, so only a view opened after counts, and it lets go when, after the bound, maild still holds the message where its row shows it.
